title: Genshin Impact Characters List (2026): All 124 Playable Characters by Region and Element
summary: Every playable Genshin Impact character as of Version 7.2, sorted by region and element, plus the newest Snezhnaya characters, release order and banners.
body_markdown:
**Quick answer:** *Genshin Impact* has **124 playable characters** as of Version 7.2 (November 2026): **72 five-star** and **52 four-star** characters, counting the Traveler and the Wonderland Manekin once each. The newest are **Mitya** (5★ Electro) and **Valeriy** (4★ Electro) from Snezhnaya. Below is every character sorted by region and by element, plus release order, the current banners and who’s coming next.


*Genshin Impact* is on **Version 7.2, “Hour of Ruin”** , released November 4, 2026 (per the[official Version 7.2 update notes](https://genshin.hoyoverse.com/en/news/detail/167187) ). The counts in this article come from the[fan-run Genshin Impact Wiki character list](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Character/List) , cross-checked against official HoYoverse update notes for the newest characters, and are current as of November 27, 2026.


Want to make your own character instead? Our[Genshin OC maker guide](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/genshin-impact-character-maker) and[32 Genshin OC ideas](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/genshin-oc-ideas) help you design an OC that fits right into Teyvat.

- **Fun gap:** no playable Mondstadt character uses Dendro yet.


##


Newest Genshin Characters (Version 7.0 to 7.2)


#


Snezhnaya, the Cryo nation, opened in Version 7.0 on August 12, 2026, and every new character since then comes from there. Here’s what HoYoverse’s official notes say about each one ([Version 7.0 notes](https://genshin.hoyoverse.com/en/news/detail/165655) ,[Version 7.1 notes](https://genshin.hoyoverse.com/en/news/detail/166383) ,[official Version 7.2 update notes](https://genshin.hoyoverse.com/en/news/detail/167187) ).


Character Rarity Element Weapon Version Official description


“Swirling Snow” Odette 5★ Cryo (Stellar Linchpin) Sword 7.0 A famed ballerina of Snezhnaya and a support who enables Stellar-Conduct and Stellar Swirl.


“Swift-Striding Hound” Alyosha 4★ Electro (Vision) Polearm 7.0 A “professional hunter” of the Snezhnayan snowfields who heals the party while dealing Electro DMG.


“Snowy Banquet’s Sharp Blade” Vesna 5★ Anemo (Stellar Linchpin) Sword 7.1 Commander of the Druzhna and “the Tsaritsa’s keen blade”; an Anemo DMG dealer.


“Lingering Siren-Song” Vodyanitsa 5★ Hydro (Vision) Catalyst 7.1 Prima Donna of the Korolevskiy Troupe and a Water Imp who has parted from her kin; healer and support.


“Rules Set at Naught” Mitya 5★ Electro (Stellar Linchpin) Catalyst 7.2 An ingenious energy specialist and “schedule-dodging” master; an Electro DPS.


“Fort Fulguration” Valeriy 4★ Electro (Vision) Sword 7.2 Commander of the Special Assignments Battalion; a support with Electro buffs and shields.


A **Stellar Linchpin** is Snezhnaya’s Vision-like device for controlling an element. Version 7.0 also let the Traveler resonate with Cryo.


##


Current Genshin Banners (November 24 to December 15, 2026)


#


Version 7.2 Phase II runs from November 24, 2026 at 18:00 to December 15, 2026 at 14:59 (server time), per the[official Phase II wish notice](https://genshin.hoyoverse.com/en/news/detail/167370) :


- **“Harmonious Abundance”:** “White Horse’s Fleeting Spring” Zibai (5★ Geo).
- **“Ya-hoho! Compendium”:** “Augur of Wonders” Linnea (5★ Geo).
- **Featured 4★ on both:** Illuga (Geo), Aino (Hydro) and Ningguang (Geo).
- **“Names Forged Beneath Blazing Skies” Chronicled Wish:** Natlan’s Varesa, Chasca, Xilonen, Mualani and Kinich, with Ifa, Iansan, Ororon and Kachina as 4★ options.


The “Harmonious Abundance” event wish banner with Zibai, Illuga, Aino and Ningguang. © HoYoverse

##


Free Genshin Characters


#


A few characters can’t be pulled from wishes at all, and a few are handed out during the early story.


- **Traveler:** your main character, available from the start.
- **Wonderland Manekin:** the customizable main character of the Miliastra Wonderland mode, added in Luna II. You don’t pull for them, and they use the Traveler’s current element.
- **Aloy:** a crossover character from the Horizon series. She was given free by in-game mail to players at Adventure Rank 20 or above in Versions 2.1 and 2.2, and she has never been on a wish banner.
- **Amber, Kaeya and Lisa:** you get them during the opening story. After that they only appear in the standard wish, Paimon’s Bargains or Chronicled Wishes.


##


Upcoming Genshin Characters


#


The fan wiki lists three characters as upcoming playable characters: **Anastasya** (Cryo, Snezhnaya), **Danica** (Electro, Snezhnaya) and **Dainsleif** (Khaenri’ah). HoYoverse hasn’t announced release dates for them, so treat any date you see online as a rumor until the official Version 7.3 preview.

FAQ

###


How many characters are in Genshin Impact?


#


As of Version 7.2 (November 2026), Genshin Impact has 124 playable characters: 72 five-star and 52 four-star, counting the Traveler and the Wonderland Manekin once each.


###


Who is the newest Genshin character?


#


Mitya (5-star Electro Catalyst) and Valeriy (4-star Electro Sword) are the newest. Both are from Snezhnaya and were released in Version 7.2 on November 4, 2026.


###


Which Genshin region has the most characters?


#


Mondstadt has the most playable characters with 24, followed by Liyue with 22 and Inazuma with 17.


###


What is the most common element in Genshin?


#


Cryo and Electro are tied, with 21 playable characters each. Dendro has the fewest, with 12.


###


Who is on the current Genshin banner?


#


From November 24 to December 15, 2026, the character banners feature Zibai and Linnea (both 5-star Geo), with Illuga, Aino and Ningguang as the featured 4-star characters.
